primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-shriek-well-defined (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3297-3303

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: work with the torsion ring case (the bounded-below torsion variant is the same argument); the category of compactifications of X over Y is cofiltered by the Nagata theorem and two More on Flatness lemmas; a compactification yields the functor R overline-f_* after j_! via a K-injective resolution; a morphism g between compactifications yields an isomorphism of functors through the chain mediated by lemma-shriek-lqf-and-proper; since the category is cofiltered, a footnote cancellation argument reduces well-definedness to compositions of morphisms being sent to compositions of isomorphisms; a third compactification calculation reduces this to the agreement of the underlying j_! structure maps with their composite, which follows from lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose via the special-case identification with lemma-shriek-proper-and-open (source lines 3305-3373)
